title.rendered: I Am the Temple of the Holy Spirit: The Gospel For Today

excerpt.rendered: Do you not know that your bodies are temples of the Holy Spirit, who is in you, whom you have received from God? The God of all creation has chosen your body as His dwelling place.

content.rendered:
Do you not know that your bodies are temples of the Holy Spirit, who is in you, whom you have received from God? The God of all creation has chosen your body as His dwelling place. This is the most astonishing truth about being human in Christ.

The Gospel For Today | Saturday, July 11, 2026

Today’s Scripture

“Do you not know that your bodies are temples of the Holy Spirit, who is in you, whom you have received from God? You are not your own; you were bought at a price. Therefore honor God with your bodies.”
1 Corinthians 6:19-20 (NIV)

Today’s Message

Paul writes 1 Corinthians 6 to address moral confusion in the Corinthian church. The city was famous in the ancient world for its sexual permissiveness. Some believers in the church were drifting back into the old habits, reasoning that what they did with their bodies did not affect their spiritual lives. Paul’s response is one of the most theologically loaded passages in the New Testament. Your body is not just yours to use. Your body is the temple of the Holy Spirit Himself.

The Greek word Paul uses for “temple” is naos. It is not the general word for the temple complex. It is the specific word for the innermost sanctuary, the Holy of Holies, the dwelling place of God. In the Old Testament, the naos was the place where the presence of God resided behind the veil. Only the high priest could enter, and only once a year, with the blood of atonement. Paul says that, in Christ, the believer’s body has become that very dwelling place. The presence of God now resides inside the believer.

This is the staggering claim of New Testament Christianity. The same God whose presence filled Solomon’s temple with cloud so thick the priests could not stand to minister has now chosen the believer’s body as His ongoing dwelling place. The Holy Spirit does not visit you. He lives in you. He has taken up residence. The body you are walking around in is the sanctuary of the living God.

The implications are both honouring and weighty. Honouring because every believer, regardless of background or circumstance, is now a walking temple of the Holy Spirit. There is no second-class believer. There is no body God refuses to dwell in. Every Christian, in every nation, in every season, carries the indwelling Spirit of the living God in their very flesh. Weighty because the way we treat our bodies, sexually, physically, in terms of what we put into them and what we use them for, now matters in a way it could not have before. The body is no longer just personal property. It is sacred ground.

For Gospelbuzz readers, the truth this morning is breathtaking. The God of all creation lives in you. Your body is His temple. The Spirit who hovered over the waters at creation, who descended on Jesus at the Jordan, who fell on the disciples at Pentecost, is the same Spirit who took up residence in you the moment you believed. Honour that today. Walk in it. You are a temple.

Prayer

Father, I acknowledge that my body is the temple of the Holy Spirit. The God of all creation has chosen me as His dwelling place. I am not my own. I was bought at a price. The Spirit lives in me. I honour You with my body today. I walk through this day knowing that I carry Your presence wherever I go. The temple is open. The Spirit is at home. I live, move and have my being in the reality that You dwell in me by Your Spirit. In Jesus’ name. Amen.

Declaration

My body is the temple of the Holy Spirit. The God of all creation lives in me. I am not my own. I was bought at a price. I honour Him with my body today.
